nodes.name: main.cpp
nodes.summary: Application entry point: GLFW init, GLAD load, bootstraps Game object, runs frame loop

nodes.name: Config.h
nodes.summary: Shared constants in cfg namespace: NUM_LANES=4, board bounds, COIN_VALUE, physics timings

nodes.name: Characters.h
nodes.summary: CharacterDef struct and EnemyType/CharType enums for all 6 unit types (3 heroes, 3 enemies)

nodes.name: Characters.cpp
nodes.summary: Geometry helper functions for character units (scale, height, width)

nodes.name: Game.h
nodes.summary: Central header: GameState enum, Unit/Projectile/Collectible/Explosion structs, Game class declaration

nodes.name: Game.cpp
nodes.summary: Core game logic: state machine, unit placement, swept-segment projectile combat, coin economy, win/loss

nodes.name: WaveSystem.h
nodes.summary: Declares wave system: Enemy struct, global wave state, updateWaveSystem/spawnEnemy/resetWaves

nodes.name: WaveSystem.cpp
nodes.summary: Wave spawning engine: 3-wave schedule (3, 5, 10 enemies), random lane assignment, timing

nodes.name: Renderer.h
nodes.summary: Declares Renderer class: OpenGL batched quad drawing, pixel font (5x7 bitmap), viewport management

nodes.name: Renderer.cpp
nodes.summary: OpenGL 3.3 batched renderer: shader compile, single VAO/VBO for all sprites, letterboxed viewport

nodes.name: HeroSprites.h
nodes.summary: ASCII art pixel arrays and palettes for Iron Man hero units (Melee, Ranged, Defense)

nodes.name: EnemySprites.h
nodes.summary: ASCII art pixel arrays and palettes for Doombot enemy types (Easy, Medium, Hard)

nodes.name: Sprites.h
nodes.summary: Declares buildSprites function and sprite-index constants for the game

nodes.name: Sprites.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements buildSprites: converts ASCII art grids to triangles uploaded to Renderer VAO

nodes.name: UI.h
nodes.summary: Declares CardBar struct and battlefield/menu drawing function prototypes

nodes.name: UI.cpp
nodes.summary: Hero card-bar HUD, animated battlefield grid, all menu screens (main, settings, pause, win/loss)

nodes.name: Background.h
nodes.summary: Declares Background class: texture loading, rendering, thumbnail picker for 5 switchable backgrounds

nodes.name: Background.cpp
nodes.summary: OpenGL background renderer: loads PNG textures, draws cover-fit backgrounds, thumbnail selector

nodes.name: Cutscene.h
nodes.summary: Declares Cutscene class with start/update/draw/skip/finished lifecycle methods

nodes.name: Cutscene.cpp
nodes.summary: 18-second scripted intro cutscene with time-based panel animations and audio cues

nodes.summary: Declares Audio namespace: init/shutdown, music control, SFX playback, voice lines

nodes.name: Audio.cpp
